name_zh: 吉尔吉斯·阿拉马别科夫：图兰主义游牧与苏联独立
name_en: Kyrgyz Atambayev: Turanism Nomadism & Soviet Independence
description_zh: 阿拉马别科夫 (1956-) 吉尔吉斯斯坦总统 (2011-2017)，推行图兰主义泛突厥主义外交，平衡俄中美影响力，推动吉尔吉斯语言复兴与游牧文化传承，2017年和平交权打破中亚终身制惯例。
description_en: Almazbek Atambayev (1956-) Kyrgyzstan President (2011-2017), pursued Turanism pan-Turkic diplomacy, balanced Russia China US influence, promoted Kyrgyz language revival and nomadic culture transmission, 2017 peaceful handover broke Central Asian lifetime rule precedent.
reason_zh: 阿拉马别科夫代表后苏联中亚民主转型的罕见案例，展示了小国如何通过泛突厥身份外交与游牧文化复兴实现战略自主，同时实现权力和平交接。
reason_en: Atambayev represents rare post-Soviet Central Asian democratic transition case, demonstrating how small state achieves strategic autonomy through pan-Turkic identity diplomacy and nomadic culture revival while achieving peaceful power transfer.
steps_zh: 研究阿拉马别科夫早年苏联经济官僚与反对派领袖经历
分析2010年革命上台与图兰主义外交战略
探讨马纳斯机场美军基地关闭与俄罗斯关系重塑
评估吉尔吉斯语复兴与游牧文化节庆制度化
总结2017年和平交权热恩别科夫与后续政治博弈
steps_en: Study Atambayev early Soviet economic bureaucrat and opposition leader experience
Analyze 2010 revolution accession and Turanism diplomacy strategy
Explore Manas Airport US base closure and Russia relationship reset
Evaluate Kyrgyz language revival and nomadic culture festival institutionalization
Summarize 2017 peaceful handover to Jeenbekov and subsequent political game
expected_zh: 掌握图兰主义外交与游牧文化复兴双重战略，理解中亚小国民主转型的艰难与可能性，评估和平交权对中亚政治文化的破冲意义。
expected_en: Master Turanism diplomacy and nomadic culture revival dual strategy, understand Central Asian small state democratic transition difficulty and possibility, evaluate peaceful handover breakthrough significance for Central Asian political culture.
case_zh: 2010 革命上台；2011 当选总统；2014 关闭马纳斯美军基地；2017 和平交权。图兰主义游牧苏联独立范式永存。
case_en: 2010 revolution accession; 2011 elected President; 2014 closed Manas US base; 2017 peaceful handover. Turanism nomadism Soviet independence paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Democratic transition model; pan-Turkic diplomacy; nomadic culture; peaceful handover
